title: Adalen 31
actors: Peter Schildt, Kerstin Tidelius, Roland Hedlund
plot: During a strike strike-breakers are being transported to Lunde, where they are assaulted by the strikers. The military are sent in. On the 14th May 1931 there is a confrontation between demonstrators and the military who open fire...
awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 6 wins & 4 nominations total
